paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.

model_annotations.German: The bar chart compares the accuracy of Vanilla CoT and TLDR (Ours) on four benchmark datasets, specifically GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, using the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B model. The horizontal axis lists the categories, labeled as GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, in a fixed order, while the vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, marked at intervals of 20. Each category has a pair of bars, with Vanilla CoT represented by a light yellow bar and TLDR (Ours) by a green bar. The accuracy values for Vanilla CoT are approximately 89.4%, 86.8%, 42.9%, and 81.5% for GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, respectively, while TLDR (Ours) has corresponding values of around 87.7%, 87.4%, 41.2%, and 83.1%. The percentage change between the two methods is annotated above each pair of bars, showing a decrease of 1.7% for GSM8K and AIME, an increase of 0.6% for MATH500, and an increase of 1.6% for AMC. The bars are grouped by category, with no specific sorting order beyond the fixed category order on the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the color distinction between Vanilla CoT and TLDR (Ours).
